script.speaker: brooke
script.text: poll's closed, dinner crew! curry 3, 'surprise me' 1

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: surprise me is a real answer!! but fine. curry. i'm down

script.speaker: mina
script.text: curry sounds perfect :) maya, you went quiet right after you voted. everything okay?

script.speaker: maya
script.text: better than okay. a plan i pitched got picked at work today. the whole team's running with it

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: MAYA!! that's huge. celebration curry at the fancy end of the market, let's do it

script.speaker: maya
script.text: celebrate, yes. fancy end, no. a pat on the back isn't a paycheck, and the trip fund still eats first

script.speaker: maya
script.text: street-cart prices, please. one step up from that and i'm counting coins the whole walk home

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: ok ok. cheap AND celebratory. i can work with that

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: so proud of you maya! ok, my news: i'm pacing my cousin through her first 10k at 7am tomorrow

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: so tonight i need fuel, not a food coma. fresh and clean, please

script.speaker: mina
script.text: a 10k! i'm making her a sign for the finish line :)

script.speaker: maya
script.text: mina, tonight's your night too. i still think about your face on sushi day, when cyrus slid that menu over with a whole page of meat-free picks. you ordered like a kid let loose in a candy shop

script.speaker: mina
script.text: you were there for that! not one dish i had to ask about. no meat, no fish, just pick and eat... if most of tonight's board is like that, i'm happy :)

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: then mina picks first tonight. that's the rule

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: ok unrelated, but i stole one sip of my roommate's iced latte last night and regretted it until 2am

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: roxy. a lot of curries are made with cream, yogurt or butter

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: ...oh. ok, none of that in my sauce. my stomach is still mad about the latte

script.speaker: mina
script.text: it's going to be such a good night :) assistant, we're all yours

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: last one to the market buys the napkins!!
